{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D || E

!width="5%" | 1
!width="38%" colspan="2"| ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|Section 7]]''
|width="19%"|"There are secrets where fairies don't live" and this lake is peculiar for not having a fairy.  A few notes on the {{im/loz|Item|Whistle}} will reveal the location of the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 7|seventh dungeon]].
|width="19%"|This is a lake where one of the life granting fairies live.
!width="19%" rowspan="3"| ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 6|Section 6]]''
|-
! 2
|width="19%"|
|width="19%"| By burning down the lower right tree, you will reveal a stairwell that leads to 10 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|
|
|-
!3
|
|This is the Lost Woods.  Only by passing through the woods in the proper sequence, can you hope to escape to the west.  By paying the woman in the lower left corner of Hyrule, you can learn that sequence: North, West, South, West.
|The tree at the top of the single column of trees can be burned down to reveal a stairwell, where a {{im/loz|Item|Red Moblin}} will give Link 100 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.  The stairwell can also serve as a shortcut between the two sections of this area.
|If you burn the lower tree just left of center, you will find a stairwell, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|-
!4
|Inside this cave, you will find a woman who you can bribe for information. If you give her 30 rupees, she will tell you how to get through the Lost Woods. Don't give her 10 or 50, because in this case the old woman won't tell you anything and you will waste your money.
|If you bomb the wall just right of the crack, you will find a cave where a {{im/loz|Item|Red Moblin}} lives who will give you 30 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|
|
|This is the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 3|third dungeon]].
|}

== 2nd Quest ==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D || E
|-
!width="5%" | 1
!width="38%" colspan="2"| ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|Section 7]]''
|width="19%"|There may be secrets where faries don't live, but this lake is in fact an ordinary lake now.
|width="19%"|This is a lake where one of the life granting fairies live.
!width="19%" rowspan="3"| ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 6|Section 6]]''
|-
! 2
|width="19%"|
|width="19%"| By burning down the lower right tree, you will reveal a stairwell that leads to 10 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|
|By burning the lower left tree, you will find the entrance to the home of the richest {{im/loz|Item|Red Moblin}} in the 2nd quest, the only Moblin that will give you 100 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|-
! 3
|Blowing the whistle in this area will cause a staircase to appear.  Descend the staircase to discover a man playing the Money Making game.
|This is the Lost Woods.  Only by passing through the woods in the proper sequence, can you hope to escape to the west.  By paying the woman in the lower left corner of Hyrule, you can learn that sequence: North, West, South, West.
|
|If you burn the lower tree just left of center, you will find a stairwell, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|-
! 4
|Inside this cave, you will find a woman who you can bribe for information.  The more you pay, the more she'll say.
|
|Blowing the whistle in this area will cause a staircase to appear.  Descend the staircase to discover an entrance, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|
|No longer can you find a dungeon entrance in this location.  Instead, you will simply find a shop that sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 160 rupees, a {{im/loz|Item|Key}} for 100 rupees, or the {{im/loz|Item|Blue Candle}} for 60 rupees.
|}
